top_signals.title: US Gulf Allies Confront Escalation Fears
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Jon Herskovitz details Donald Trump’s dual-track Iran strategy, balancing regional diplomatic talks against a US military buildup. Meanwhile, Gulf allies fear renewed strikes could trigger severe Iranian retaliation against critical energy infrastructure. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Binance Details $3.6 Billion in Net Outflows
top_signals.summary: Binance posted a net outflow of $3.6 billion in cryptoassets after restoring customer withdrawals on Sunday, following the largest cyber theft in history attributed to North Korean hackers. Bloomberg's Suvashree Ghosh breaks down the latest developments. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: South Korea to double spending on AI and chips in 2027

top_signals.title: North Korea touts BBQ restaurant boom, but skeptics dismiss it as propaganda
top_signals.summary: Analysts say the openings reflect a push by North Korean leader Kim Jong Un to portray a growing prosperity across the country.
